issues.on_page: SEWER FUND column: line 3 beginning 35,323.00; line 21 receipts 35,900.00; p2 Debt Service 18,915.00 + Wastewater 10,370.00 + Transfers Out 9,216.00 = 38,501.00; line 28 ending 32,722.00
issues.issue: The Sewer Fund (a utility fund) has its own clean column (35,323 + 35,900 - 29,285 - 9,216 = 32,722), so business_type should not be null and its lines should not be governmental. The Lagoon Equipment Replacement and Lagoon Emergency Reserve funds (funded by Sewer transfers) may also be business-type.
